'''Armoured zombies''' are [[monster]]s that can be found randomly on [[Uncharted Isles]], alongside their [[Zombie (Uncharted Isles)|non-armoured counterparts]]. They may be killed for combat experience and [[chimes]]. While not aggressive, they are accurate and can hit hard if players are unprepared for combat. The zombies are usually found in large groups making it very dangerous to use area-of-effect attacks or abilities against them.

Attacking armoured zombies will scale their [[life points]] and combative abilities to the player's own combat level.

The zombies will always be found near an overturned [[Potions (Uncharted Isles)|cauldron with potions]] laying about; this acts as their respawn point.
